class.name: SignallingSystemNode
class.brief_description: A node proxy of a signalling system: creates it with an implementation and groups signal heads by name.
class.description: A [SignallingServer] system in a scene: creates it on entering the tree with the [member implementation] set here and groups the signal heads listed by name (also those registered later). A scenery creates its systems on the server directly; this node is for hand-built scenes.

method.name: send_event
method.description: Sends [param event] with [param arguments] to the system ([method SignallingServer.system_send_event]).

members.member: What drives the system's signal heads.
The signal heads the system groups, by name - also those registered later.
